title: Unit Event — Kick It Up a Notch — Episode8 Higher Than The Highest Peak

meta.Episode: Episode8 — Higher Than The Highest Peak
meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD is all set to perform at "Crawl Green" and are very excited about it. Kohane and the others are also looking forward to seeing Taiga there, but he happens to get a phone call which...

rows.Line: Crawl Green

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
(Wow, Azusawa's beyond legit...
Now I feel embarrassed about saying that she might repeat what she did during STAY GOLDEN.)

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
(Still, what an atmosphere...!
We can't let what she created go to waste!)

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line:
We're not letting her hog all the glory!
Let's hear it, you guys! Show us what you got!
Backstage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
That was an insane performance.
You should rest until it's our turn, so try to get your voice back by then!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Okay...! Thanks, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: The way you sang gave the rest of us so much energy! It's totally fine if you lie down, so try to recover some strength before it's you guys' turn!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay...!
I kind of want to watch everyone from backstage.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane! That was awesome...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here, take this! You need to stay hydrated!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, thanks. I really appreciate it...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Next is...this guy!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(...?!
Whoa, this place...! It's totally on fire!)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (Azusawa created this absolutely electric atmosphere for us, and EVER sent everyone flying sky high.)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
(Now it's my turn, and...
I'm gonna do things my way!)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I know you guys can do better than that! Let's have some fun! It's time to get in the groove and dance to the rhythm!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
When did Kotaro get this good?!
I really love the way he sings! It's so easy to dance to!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: (I'm projecting my voice way better than usual! The crowd's totally into it and I'm nailing every word of the lyrics! This is amazing!)

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Tono! Take it away!

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (Haha. What a show. I've never experienced this kind of atmosphere before. It's so hot that just breathing is making my throat dry out.)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (Still, I can't get what Kohane did out of my mind. I've been desperately wanting to sing after witnessing that...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: (I may be at my limit already...)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
You can all still keep going, right?
Let's keep this energy up!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa! Tono's gotten better too!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Wait, has he always been this aggressive? His presence is almost overwhelming...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Azusawa, we're up soon. How do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm all warmed up and ready to sing whenever!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? What's up...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're ready too, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah. Thanks, Akito...
I'm all set to go, so you can count on me!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, don't forget what we promised. We're gonna totally blow the roof off this place, right?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, you remembered...

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line:
Next is our headliners...!
Take it away, Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, here we go...!
We're gonna make it so everyone here goes home saying this was the best event ever! Including the owner!

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Give it everything you've got!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Akito! You gotta do better than that time you were here with Shepard!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You know I will!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This atmosphere... It's almost unprecedented... I couldn't tell at all from backstage.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This pressure... What an incredible feeling...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've never felt this much energy before...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Man! All I wanna do right now is sing my lungs out!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I don't understand...
It's like I can see the faces of everyone in the audience even better now.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're all sweaty and exhausted... But I also get the sense that they want us to sing and energize this place even more!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here we go! Try to keep up, you guys!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm okay. Because there's only one thing that I need to do here...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Don't think about anything else besides singing...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's so nice to have An here next to me. I feel like we can reach all the people I couldn't when I was by myself...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Right now... We can do anything...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Kohane's so good right now... Scary good...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(But for some reason...
Singing together like this... I feel like we can do anything.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(The way Azusawa's singing...
It's like she's trying to push us forward.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Are we all managing to hang on?
I'm not sure, but this energy... It's so compelling, yet comfortable.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've always wondered how far Kohane could go, but I didn't realize she could be this good a singer...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And the way she's singing... She's trying to push us higher.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Which means there's only one thing we need to do. We need to use this energy to fly even higher!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Shinonome's jumped out in front...
The way he's singing... It has such a powerful allure...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I've never seen such an excited audience. More excited than when I sang by myself.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I thought I'd used up all of my energy, but I'm still going. And I'm feeling hotter and hotter.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I want to go as high as I can!
And I want to keep going even higher!)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: This event's totally off the hook...!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Yeah! Everyone has been so good!

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
(This event...
It might actually be able to match RADder's...!)

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
(Also, that kid...
He's come a long way to be able to put on something like this.)

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line:
When RADder debuted...
When RAD WEEKEND happened...and became the stuff of legends...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I've become convinced that I'll never get to see an event like that again.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Actually, you may be in for a bit of a surprise...

rows.Speaker: Owner of Crawl Green
rows.Line: I think you were right, Ken...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (We're seeing their true capabilities here.)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: (A part of me has been wondering this whole time...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: If anyone's going to surpass what happened that night, I'd have to say...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (I met that girl for the first time after she performed at STAY GOLDEN. I saw a tiny part of Nagi in her, but it was fragmented and incomplete...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
(Which caught my attention.
This all began with me being curious.)

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line: I have a feeling that the next generation of singers is going to help keep our dream alive...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: The next generation, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
(Hah...
I guess a part of me felt the same way as Nagi...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (Not all of me...)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: (That night... I decided to take our music and carry it even further...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Taiga...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess it's my own fault for half-heartedly getting mixed up in other people's business.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I'm going, Ken.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You know this all too well...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I don't like getting involved while not being able to fully commit myself. And there's one last thing that I need to do now.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: So, I'm going to get that out of the way and return to what I was doing.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Wow, I'm parched...!
I don't think I can even walk!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, I'm exhausted too...
Actually, I think we're all totally spent.

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: Yes, we'll need to keep working on our stamina.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree... Still, I believe we put on our best performance to date during this event.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And we definitely have Azusawa to thank for that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She seems the most exhausted out of all of us. But I guess she should be since she sang the most.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You did so awesome, Kohane...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh. Hehe. An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I did it...
And it's because you guys all said that you believed in me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Also, An, you telling me that you wanted to hear me at my best especially helped...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was pretty afraid of singing all by myself, but I'm so glad that I did... Thanks for believing in me, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh...
No, I'm just really tired!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm gonna go outside to get some fresh air...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, okay... See you in a bit.

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
How awesome was that event?!
And that girl in the beginning! She was so good!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Yeah, but so was everyone else!
And the atmosphere they created... They're really trying to surpass RAD WEEKEND, right?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: At this rate, they might actually succeed!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Hey, did you guys just...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It sounds like we may actually succeed...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we've definitely made some progress, but we can't let up here...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But that's really nice to hear...
I hope we can keep up this momentum.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh, also...
I hope Taiga and An's dad enjoyed the show.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can't say if we were able to surpass the first event Taiga and his team put on...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But for now, as long as everyone enjoyed our event...)
Several dozen minutes later
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I only have a few days left before I leave.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Before that...

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: That girl needs to know. What was “most important” to us was nothing so cute.
